versions.content: If the Service Discovery Module receives an OfferService Entry while the current state SD_CLIENT_SERVICE_REQUESTED is for this Client Service Instance , the following step(s) shall be performed in the following order: - Cancel the repetition timer . - If recei ved TTL is not equal to the max value, set the TTL timer for this entry to the received TTL value. - Open TCP connection if SdClientServiceTcpRef is configured and was not opened before . - Leave the Repetition Phase immediately and enter the Main Phase.

If the Service Discovery Module receives an OfferService Entry while the current state SD_CLIENT_SERVICE_REQUESTED is for this Client Service Instance , the following step(s) shall be performed in the following order: - Cancel the repetition timer . - If recei ved TTL is not equal to the max value, set the TTL timer for this entry to the received TTL value. - Open TCP connection if SdClientServiceTcpRef is configured and was not opened before . - Leave the Repetition Phase immediately and enter the Main Phase.

If the Service Discovery Module receives an OfferService Entry while the current state SD_CLIENT_SERVICE_REQUESTED is for this Client Service Instance, the following step(s) shall be performed in the following order: • Cancel the repetition timer. • If received TTL is not equal to the max value, set the TTL timer for this entry to the received TTL value. • Open TCP connection if SdClientServiceTcpRef is configured and was not opened before. • Leave the Repetition Phase immediately and enter the Main Phase. • Handle subscription as described in [SWS_Sd_00376] and [SWS_Sd_00721] in the same offer cycle
